description: For every shared quantifier-free matrix, the executable numerical procedure accepts its exact syntax code if and only if its existential–universal sentence has a nonempty model.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.decideCode_correct (c : ℕ) (arities : List ℕ) {m n : ℕ}
  (φ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.lang c arities).BoundedFormula Empty (m + n))
  (hq : φ.IsQF) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.decideCode c arities m n
        (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.formulaCode
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.signature c arities) Empty.elim φ) =
      true ↔
    ∃ M x, ∃ (_ : Nonempty M), M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.sentence c arities φ
